hypotheses.claim: A single global depot-distance scale mean(d[0,1:]) normalizing a generalized Clarke-Wright savings score (edge-weight lam, radial asymmetry mu, dimensionless capacity-fill bonus beta) preserves the far-from-depot priority ordering while improving capacity packing, so the L2a static-merge template with postprocess_mode=none reaches mean tour length <= 16.14 on cvrp_dev_hetero_24 at 500 ms with 0 timeouts, whereas per-pair normalization (d0i+d0j-dij)/(d0i+d0j) degrades it to ~17.0-18.1.

next_search_advice.direction: Evolve the static pairwise merge score into a globally scale-normalized generalized savings rule: score(i,j) = (d0i + d0j - lam*dij + mu*|d0i - d0j|)/mean(d0,1..n) + beta*clip((qi+qj)/Q,0,1) with lam in [1.00,1.15], mu in [0.08,0.15], beta in [0.05,0.15], optionally plus a dimensionless endpoint demand-balance term 1-|qi-qj|/(qi+qj); forbid per-pair normalization by (d0i+d0j).
